title: 2026-09-21 | PRE-MARKET RADAR
summary: Six of twelve watchlist names are sitting on a technical level going into Monday's US open. AMZN and IBKR are the cleanest tests; TSLA is near a level but inside a downtrend. Research, not a buy list; no orders placed.
regime: The Fed raised rates 25bp on 16 Sep to 3.75 to 4.00%; the 10-year yield pushed above 5%. A rotation, not a broad flush.
footnote: Levels are weekly swing lows plus 10, 20 and 40-week moving averages from IBKR bars (Fri 18 Sep close). 13F data is a 30 June snapshot filed mid-August.
